reviews.text: Small pet store, similar selection to Arken Zoo in Sweden.

I went on Ascension Thursday; two salespeople were focused on talking to each other, one was busy at the checkout. The price tags on the frozen foods were very unclear, but the biggest surprise came at the checkout: a plastic bag for 1€!? And that wasn't mentioned anywhere.
In my case, the customer service response time was about two weeks, which seemed unreasonably long.

is a very small shop with a limited but well-organized selection. Everything is neatly arranged, and what really stands out is how friendly and helpful the staff is.

A great little place if you’re looking for something specific and appreciate good service.
We went to buy food for our dog as we run out of it. Thry didn't have big choice of veteritary food, but overall place has many snacks/food/clothes and etc. For pets
A very well-stocked store; for example, we found a dog bowl for the 80th anniversary of the Moomins, which we immediately bought for our Frenchie. They also have food in addition to accessories.
There were no tropical fish items.
Really good service. I had bought a leash for my dog ​​here and it unexpectedly broke. The product was replaced with a new, more durable one.
It's always nice to visit here when the customer service is so helpful and you can find everything you need!
Absolutely the best service from all Muste and Mirre! The sellers know their stuff :)

I was in this store on September 24, 2024. I was greeted very unfriendly. It's a shame that they look at my appearance and immediately turn away with a dissatisfied face, but forget that I am first and foremost a customer. Now I know where I will never go.
